title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Gets the Furby Treatment With New Furblets Collection
summary: The latest KPop Demon Hunters merch drop turns the Saja Boy Demon and Derpy Tiger into the furry interactive toys.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Since premiering on Netflix in June 2025, KPop Demon Hunters has become a merchandising phenomenon , with everything from apparel and vinyl, to dolls and plush toys inspired by HUNTR/X and the film’s colorful cast of heroes and villains. Now, Hasbro is joining the lineup with an officially licensed KPop Demon Hunters Furby Furblets collection featuring mini electronic plush versions of the Saja Boy Demon and the fan-favorite Derpy Tiger.

For anyone new to the toy craze , Furby first debuted in 1998 and quickly became one of the bestselling toys of the late ’90s thanks to its interactive features, expressive personality and signature chatter. The brand has enjoyed a major comeback in recent years, fueled by a new generation of collectors and the rise of nostalgic toys on TikTok. Furblets are miniature versions of the classic Furby, offering the same playful sounds and interactive features in a pocket-sized design that’s easy to collect or clip onto a bag.

POCKET-SIZED FUN

'KPop Demon Hunters'

Furby Furblets Saja Boy Demon

$14.97

Buy Now on amazon

Buy Now on Walmart

The Saja Boy Demon Furblet headlines Hasbro’s collection with a playful personality, iconic Furby design and batteries included for out-of-the-box fun.

Measuring three inches tall, this officially licensed Furby Furblet packs plenty of personality with more than 45 sounds, pop-open ears and a removable gat-style hat. The collectible mini plush comes with a convenient keychain clip and can even sing along with the Derpy Tiger Furblet.

CLIP-ON COLLECTIBLE

Furby Furblets Derpy Tiger

The fan-favorite Derpy Tiger from the Netflix hit comes to life as a three-inch talking Furby Furblet plush.

This officially licensed Derpy Tiger Furblet brings the KPop Demon Hunters favorite to life with 45+ sounds, interactive features and adorable details. Fans can press its head, mouth and heart gem for surprises, fold its ears for a pop-open effect and clip it onto bags for easy display. Pair it with the Saja Boy Demon Furblet to create a harmonizing duo.

LIMITED-EDITION LOOK

Furby Galaxy Edition

Glow-in-the-Dark Interactive Plush Toy

$62.48

Standing more than six inches tall, this full-size Furby is an Amazon exclusive featuring a glow-in-the-dark design.

The iconic Furby is back with a fresh twist, featuring glowing light effects, dancing moves, blinking eyes and its signature Furbish language. Standing more than six inches tall, this interactive plush friend responds to touch and can even interact with other Furby friends and Furblets.

The Furby Furblets collection joins a growing lineup of KPop Demon Hunters merchandise following the film’s breakout success . From Squishmallows plush and Mattel’s KPop Demon Hunters dolls to Hasbro’s NERF role-play toys, Little People Collector sets , Old Navy apparel, Vans footwear and more, the franchise continues to make its mark across pop culture.
